15:                sessions[tenant_id][user] = {}
16:            sessions[tenant_id][user][client_name] = client_config
17:
18:# Save the configurations in the new format
19:with open("configurations.json", "w") as f:
20:    json.dump({"sessions": sessions}, f, indent=4)
